grammar.summary: 本课学习 would 表过去的意愿与 suggest that 虚拟（初步）。

points.title: suggest 表建议
points.explanation: He suggested that a double railway-tunnel should be built. suggest/recommend/insist 后接 should do（虚拟语气初步），should 常省略：suggest that sb. (should) do。

examples.en: He suggested that a double railway-tunnel should be built.

points.title: would 表过去将来意愿
points.explanation: He said he would be able to... would do 过去将来。
